name: FlightAware AeroAPI
summary: FlightAware's flight-tracking API: live and recent flight status, tracks and positions, airport arrivals, departures, delays and weather, airline schedules and operator details.

api_key.description: An AeroAPI key (flightaware.com/aeroapi/portal > API keys), sent in the x-apikey header.

notes: Every call is billed: each endpoint has a fee per result set (15 records), and a call that returns several pages pays for each page, up to max_pages. Fees run from $0.002 (airport weather) to $0.05 (flight search) per set and more for history; the Personal tier includes $5 of free usage a month.
Rate limits by tier: Personal 10 result sets a minute, Standard 5 a second, Premium 100 a second.
Prefer ICAO codes (KJFK, UAL, UAL1234) over IATA to avoid ambiguous matches.
Paging: links.next is a link to the next set of records; pass its cursor value back as cursor.
Alerts, flight intents, maps, Foresight and history endpoints are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get a flight's status
endpoints.summary: Status, times (scheduled, estimated, actual), gates, route and aircraft for recent and upcoming flights of an ident, registration or fa_flight_id.

ident.description: Flight ident (ICAO form preferred, e.g. UAL1234), registration, or fa_flight_id.

ident_type.description: How to read ident; by default it is taken as a registration when it could be one.

start.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime, inclusive; no more than 10 days back or 2 days ahead. Defaults to about 14 days of recent and scheduled flights.

end.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime, exclusive; same window.

max_pages.description: Pages to fetch in this call, default 1; each page returned is billed.

cursor.description: links.next cursor from the previous response, for the next page.

notes: Billed per result set returned: max_pages above 1 bills each page fetched.
Use the ICAO ident (UAL1234) rather than IATA (UA1234) to avoid matching the wrong flight.

endpoints.name: Search airborne flights
endpoints.summary: Flights in the air now matching a query: area, ident or type wildcards, origin, destination, altitude, speed.

query.description: '-key value' pairs, e.g. -origin KLAX -type B77*, or -latlong "MINLAT MINLON MAXLAT MAXLON"; keys include -prefix, -type, -idents, -identOrReg, -airline, -destination, -origin, -originOrDestination, -aboveAltitude, -belowAltitude, -aboveGroundspeed, -belowGroundspeed, -filter ga|airline. Max 1000 bytes.

max_pages.description: Pages to fetch in this call, default 1; each page returned is billed.

cursor.description: links.next cursor from the previous response, for the next page.

notes: Billed per result set returned: max_pages above 1 bills each page fetched.
Among the dearer calls per result set; narrow the query and keep max_pages low.

endpoints.name: Get a flight's track
endpoints.summary: Positions (time, lat, lon, altitude, speed) along a flight from the last 10 days.
notes: Older than 10 days needs the history endpoints, which are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get a flight's latest position
endpoints.summary: The most recent position report of a flight.

endpoints.name: Get an airport
endpoints.summary: Name, city, state, coordinates and time zone of an airport.

id.description: Airport code: ICAO preferred (KJFK), IATA or LID also accepted.

end.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime, exclusive; same window.

max_pages.description: Pages to fetch in this call, default 1; each page returned is billed.

endpoints.summary: Scheduled flights airlines have published, from 3 months back to a year ahead, by date window, route, airline or flight number.

date_end.description: Latest departure; no later than a year ahead and at most 3 weeks after date_start.
